name: extension-colophon-placement
description: The colophon-placement extension enabled ALONGSIDE auto-license-page, because the pair is the point of this fixture. Both draw a back-matter page from the same hook — the :back call to ink_cover_page, the only point after all body content and before the back cover — and drawing directly in that hook made the page order depend on which extension was prepended last, producing two different documents from the same source. SC-015b forbids that. The reference pins the intended order (colophon, then licence page) as produced by the ranked back-matter queue that replaced the direct drawing. The colophon is written FIRST in the source so a reference in which it still appears there would mean the extension did nothing, and the contents list must not mention it.
